conviction_note: A near non-result. NOVAGOLD is pre-revenue and its print reactions are set by the gold tape and the Donlin timeline, not by EPS. Everything new since June 24 is already public: the Paulson 40% consolidation (July 21, vote Nov 3), the definitive proxy (Oct 5), the draft SEIS (Sept 23) and an investor deck (Sept 28). What is left is a small negative lean on a Q3 loss widened by deal costs, and on the guided step-up in Donlin spending with funding moving to 100% after closing, offset by permitting staying on schedule. p_up 48 on abs_move 6.0 (option event move 6.41, median reaction 5.01) gives -0.24, against an impact_sum of -0.5. The two agree in sign and both are small.
bar: Disputed and thin. Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-08-31) EPS consensus: -0.08 (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/NG/earnings-forecasts), -0.07 (Earnings Whispers), -0.06 (StockTwits, https://stocktwits.com/symbol/NG/earnings), an average of -0.09 elsewhere. The company bar is FY2026 spending guidance of ~$98.5m ($78.8m Donlin plus $19.7m corporate), unchanged at Q2, with Q2 cash of $370.2m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001173420/000117184326004278/exh_991.htm). The stock is down 20.86% over 20 sessions and 54.86% from its 52-week high, and has moved with gold since the Sept 16 Fed hike. The bad news is largely in the price.

findings.finding: The Army Corps released the court-ordered draft Donlin SEIS around 2026-09-23, on the 'fall 2026' schedule it gave in January, with a 30-day comment period and hearings on Oct 14-19, and a final decision still targeted for May 2027. The draft models a 27% tailings-dam failure as devastating, and Earthjustice is pressing for a 100% scenario. The Q3 release and call are the first time management can say permitting is still on schedule after the draft.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Timeline news is what moves this stock. It fell 14.13% on 2026-06-24 when the BFS slipped to 2027 (baseline; https://www.mining.com/novagold-targets-new-donlin-feasibility-study-by-end-2027-ceo/). A schedule that holds has not been tested as a print catalyst.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it has been public for two weeks, and the stock fell about 9% in the week to Oct 1 on gold. If the market read the draft SEIS as a delay risk, the stock would have dropped more than gold and GDX around Sept 23, and nothing shows that. The only part not yet seen is management confirming the schedule on the call.
findings.independence: January timeline from the Corps notice (draft fall 2026, final May 2027): https://alaskabeacon.com/2026/01/30/feds-begin-to-look-at-the-effects-of-possible-large-spill-at-a-proposed-alaska-mine/ . The company's Sept 28 deck says 'BFS completion expected 2027': https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1173420/000110465926111118/tm2625949d3_defa14a.htm

findings.finding: Q2 kept FY2026 spending guidance at ~$98.5m ($78.8m Donlin) with Q2 spending of only $22.7m, and said 'NOVAGOLD's share of Donlin Gold expenditures is expected to increase over the next 15 to 21 months'. The Paulson deal moves NG from 60% to 100% funding of Donlin after a Q4 close. Q3 is the first release that can put a number on the step-up, or on a 100%-basis or 2027 budget, while the cash pile was $370.2m at May 31.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-06-24), with higher development costs signalled and the BFS slipping, fell 14.13%. Q2 2025 fell 5.13% intraday on a wider loss (https://www.itiger.com/news/1129205329).
findings.why_not_priced: The direction of the increase is guided, so only its size could surprise. Neither the definitive proxy nor the deck gives a 100%-basis budget or a 2027 spend: the DEFM14A has no budget or cash figure, and the deck repeats $98.5m and $370.2m. If the market expected a big upward reset, the 20-day drawdown would run well ahead of gold miners, and it is consistent with the stock's 2.26 beta to gold.
findings.independence: Same company line repeated in the Sept 28 investor deck (DEFA14A): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1173420/000110465926111118/tm2625949d3_defa14a.htm . This is an inference about what Q3 will disclose; no document gives the new number.

findings.finding: Q3 FY2026 (June-August) covers the signing of the Paulson arrangement (July 21) and the proxy work (PREM14A Sept 11, a Citi fairness opinion, many DEFA14As). Like Q3 FY2025, which booked $9.1m of acquisition-related expenses, the quarter will likely carry transaction costs on top of a ramping BFS, widening the net loss from Q2's $25.5m (-0.06) against a disputed -0.06 to -0.09 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY2025 (2025-10-01) was down 5% pre-market on a loss widened by $9.1m of acquisition costs (https://www.itiger.com/news/1124737275), but the baseline shows it closed the day +15.0%, so gold overrode the EPS line. Q2 2025 fell 5.13% on a wider loss caused by a warrant charge.
findings.why_not_priced: Estimate sources range from -0.06 to -0.09, and a deal-cost-driven 'wider loss' is exactly the headline that drove last year's pre-market dip. But the cost is a below-the-line one-off with no path to the Donlin value, and the bar is too disputed to call a miss. That is why it is small.
findings.independence: The proxy filing and deal timeline (DEFM14A filed Oct 5, meeting Nov 3) are confirmed by the Oct 5 8-K press release: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001173420/000110465926113779/tm2625949d4_ex99-1.htm . The Q3 2025 precedent comes from a different source, iTiger.

findings.finding: NG has the option to prepay the Barrick promissory note in full for $100m on or before 2026-12-03. Q2 said it plans to exercise 'later in 2026' and is 'fully funded' for it, so the Q3 release may report the exercise or a timetable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None: no prior print turned on the note.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The company guided the exercise and the cash for it, and the $100m comes out of a known $370m pile. On the financing question: the money retires legacy debt at a discount and does not signal distress, so it is a zero.

findings.finding: Gold has been under a hawkish Fed. It fell 2.55% to $4,335.68 on Sept 1 as 10-year yields reached 4.80%, and 1.2% to $4,240.10 after the Fed's 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% on Sept 16, with another hike signalled for 2026. NG (beta about 2.26) went from $7.25 on Sept 15 to $6.41, -20.86% over 20 sessions. The Oct 8 gold tape, not the print, is the largest single driver of the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +15.0% on 2025-10-01 and +4.23% on 2026-04-01 print days line up with gold moves rather than with the financials. The 2026-06-24 -14.13% came in the week gold broke below $4,000 (https://www.financemagnates.com/trending/why-gold-is-going-down-xauusd-price-falls-below-4000-for-first-time-since-november-2025/).
findings.why_not_priced: The drawdown so far is priced, and nobody can source the direction of gold on Oct 8. It is filed so a judge knows the window is dominated by a factor the print does not control, which widens the move and leaves the sign at a coin flip.
findings.independence: Sept 1 gold selloff, a different source: https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/gold-news-war-risk-fails-to-stop-gold-selloff-as-yields-hit-4-8-1621194 . Price levels (Sept 15 $7.25) are from the Oct 5 8-K.
